fields.label: Course Joining Instructions Title
Registration Details
fields.options:
Registration
Learners must report at the training center at 08:00 AM local time. Late arrivals must make up for lost time, which, after client notification, will incur extra charges. Learners may need to bring Personal Safety Logbooks for updating, to be returned upon course completion.

Verification of identity
Every learner must prove their identity, mandatory in the United Arab Emirates. This can be done with government-issued photographic identification (for example passport or identity document).

fields.label: Course Schedule Details
fields.options:
Total Program Day: 10 Hours
Total contact time per day: 8 Hours
Lunch Break: 40 minutes
Mid-class breaks: 20 minutes
Total Guided Learning Hours: 14-16 hours
Entry Requirements: No entry requirements
Physical & Stressful demands of this course: Prolonged sitting in the class (more than 1 hour at a stretch)
Clothing: Comfortable clothing, course is completely class room theory training.

fields.label: Learning Outcomes
fields.options:
Learning Outcomes
The learning outcomes are specified for each of the following units; they are:

OIS-102 Authorized Gas Tester:
Relevant Legislative Controls (1.1-1.11)
The principles and use of Atmosphere Measuring and Monitoring Equipment (2.1-2.10)
Interpreting and Documenting Results (3.1-3.2)

OIS-103 Testing for flammable gas in preparation for hot work:
Gas Testing for Hot work (1.1-1.14)

OIS-104 Confined Space Testing:
Gas Testing in Confined Spaces (1.1-1.13)

OIS-105 Gas Monitoring:
Providing Safety Watch duties (1.1-1.16)

fields.label: Special Needs
fields.options:
Special needs:
Course participants with special needs such as language problems, physical or medical disabilities and special attention regarding religion or culture must be stated on the training confirmation email to Training Coordinator.

fields.label: General Notes
fields.options:
General:
NUTC reserves all rights to stop a learner from participating in a course if his or her prerequisites do not comply with the rules and regulations of the authorities involved. In this case we always consult the employer before taking any further action.

During their stay at NUTC, course learners have to comply with the house rules.

NUTC is not responsible for problems of any kind that are due to lack of knowledge of the information provided in this sheet.
